definitions.bowl_displacement_m: Euclidean robot-base XYZ displacement of the bowl over the observed window.
definitions.censoring: A window ending after episode termination is unavailable; its 1--31 observed prefix actions are counted but no endpoint is interpolated, extrapolated or carried forward.
definitions.cube_displacement_m: Euclidean robot-base XYZ displacement of the cube over the observed window.
definitions.descriptor_provenance: Public output authenticates recorded descriptor byte counts, recorded content hashes and shapes from the pinned JSONL plus hashes of private recovery pointers. Payload files were not reopened or byte-reverified, and absolute prefixes are never exported.
definitions.episode_balanced: Mean complete-window metric within each cell, then descriptive summary over 27 matched seed labels per condition.
definitions.matched_complete_window_analysis: Selection-transparent LEFT/RIGHT pairing of exact complete +32 windows. It remains a post-hoc, outcome-conditioned execution-motion view and is algebraically linked to the last shared request boundary.
definitions.relative_displacement_m: Euclidean displacement of the cube-minus-bowl XYZ relation over the observed window.
definitions.request_level: Descriptive complete-window requests; variable request counts do not represent independent episodes.
definitions.signed_lateral_relative_change_m: Change in robot-base (cube_y-bowl_y); positive is toward robot LEFT.
definitions.window: Recorded simulator state at request action_step_start versus the exact observed state at start+32 actions.

definitions.first_window: Availability and selection of the 0-to-32 action window are outcome-independent in this retained cohort because all cells survive past action 32. Its exact-zero measurement duplicates the stopping-control action-32 information rather than adding an endpoint.
definitions.fixed_index_outcome_attrition: For every fixed index, the already-recorded requested-success versus administrative-cap outcome of each LEFT/RIGHT pair is cross-tabulated against exact-endpoint availability. All four pair-outcome strata and all 16 control-by-reflected joint strata remain explicit, including zero-population and zero-support strata. This is retrospective risk-set composition only: pairing ends with the shorter command trace, so it neither establishes censoring independence nor estimates an outcome-stratified motion effect, failure enrichment, language understanding or a model diagnosis.
definitions.fixed_request_index_profile: Each row fixes one recorded request index before comparing commands. Support requires the exact +32-action endpoint in both command cells; four-condition interactions require all four cells. Strict-positive bounds count every unavailable registered seed first as non-positive and then as positive. Later rows remain historical survival-selected action-index evidence, not physical time, independent windows, a calibrated movement test or forecast scoring.
definitions.pairing: Within a seed and layout, retain request indices whose exact +32-action endpoint exists in both LEFT and RIGHT historical cells. An otherwise-complete record is excluded when its counterpart episode ends before that endpoint; never fill a stopped counterpart.
definitions.same_support_layout_audit: The layout comparison restricts each seed to request indices complete in all four layout-command cells. This removes unequal request-index support between layouts but not historical goal/cap outcome selection.
definitions.seed_weighting: Average the matched windows within each seed; summaries then weight the 27 seed labels equally. Window counts remain variable and outcome-conditioned.
definitions.telescoping: Contiguous window contrasts sum exactly (within 1e-15 m) to the paired relative-offset response at the last shared 32-action boundary. The seed mean is that response divided by a variable window count, not independent evidence or a physical-time rate.
definitions.window_contrast: D_window = change(cube_y-bowl_y)_LEFT - change(cube_y-bowl_y)_RIGHT in robot-base coordinates. Positive means the two commands increased LEFT/RIGHT ordering over that window; exact zero is a tie without a calibrated motion threshold.
